recognition: OSI members have received five Presidential Volunteer Service Awards.
notes: Impact totals supplied by the user; dated timeline contains only documented events. Museum volunteering appears as an event with a photo; its date has not been supplied. $2,000 has been raised for the micro:bit robotics education project, confirmed by the user on November 3, 2026. Plant value and 500-plant project are separate achievements. Meals total is not attributed solely to Gleaners. The 300+ volunteer hours are with Absolute Home Health and Hospice alone, one of OSI’s collaborators, and are not a total across all collaborators. Absolute volunteering appears as a 2024 event in Our Journey, with its official logo and 300+ volunteer hours. The museum is also a timeline event; neither uses an Also part of our journey block. The 12-event total is unchanged. The user supplied 7,000 people at OSI’s largest event; this is event attendance, not a claim that OSI directly served every attendee. Food assistance and environmental service stories are separate click-through pages; their full content is absent from the home page. The Rochester Heritage Festival story is a separate Community Events subpage, linked from Events and the festival journey entry; its full story and gallery are absent from the home page. OSI has completed 4,000 total volunteer hours, confirmed by the user on October 5, 2026. BBCC service is 40 hours in 2024; these hours are part of the overall total. BBCC is a community partnership, not an event; moved to Community per the user on October 27, 2026.
